# All-in-One Construction Workforce Management Software


Lumber automates scheduling, time tracking, payroll, HR, and more for building contractors. Discover effortless construction workforce management software today.


## Meetings and Demos
- [Pre-book a meeting](https://www.lumberfi.com/sage-future): Schedule a meeting to discuss Lumber's solutions and how they can benefit your construction business.
- [Book a demo](https://www.lumberfi.com/demo-sign-up): Experience a live demonstration of Lumber's features and capabilities.


## Human Resources Management
- [HR](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/hr): Explore Lumber's HR management tools for the construction industry.
- [Applicant Tracking System](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/hr/applicant-tracking-system): Manage job applications and streamline hiring.
- [Referral Program](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/hr/referral-program): Incentivize employee referrals efficiently.
- [Multi-Platform Job Posting](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/hr/multi-platform-job-posting): Post openings across multiple platforms.
- [Smart Candidate Matching](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/hr/smart-candidates-matching): AI-driven candidate-job matching.
- [Streamlined Onboarding](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/hr/streamlined-onboarding): Simplify onboarding for new hires.


## Scheduling and Time Management
- [Scheduling](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/scheduler): Manage project schedules and workforce availability.
- [Track Job Schedule](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/scheduler/track-job-schedule): Monitor schedules to ensure timely completion.
- [Time Tracking](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/time-tracking): Accurately track employee hours and project time.
- [Timesheet Submission](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/time-tracking/timesheet-submission): Facilitate easy submission of timesheets.
- [Geofencing](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/time-tracking/geofencing): Track employee locations and work hours.
- [Foreman Mode](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/time-tracking/foreman-mode): Tools for foremen to manage their teams.


## Payroll and Compliance
- [Payroll](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/payroll): Manage payroll processes seamlessly.
- [Automated Payroll](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/payroll/automated-calculations): Automate calculations and disbursements.
- [Prevailing Wages](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/payroll/prevailing-wages): Ensure compliance with wage laws.
- [Union Configuration](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/payroll/union-configuration): Configure payroll for union requirements.
- [Davis Bacon Certified Payroll](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/payroll/davis-bacon-certified-payroll): Generate certified payroll reports.
- [Payroll Reports](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/payroll/payroll-reports): Access detailed payroll reports.
- [Payroll Backoffice](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/payroll/payroll-backoffice): Centralized payroll management.

- [Union Agent](https://www.lumberfi.com/product/ai/union-agent): Turn complex CBAs into clear AI insights.
